items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: He had a lot of 78 records with blues by Betsy Smith, Mamie Smith, Ida Cox and all these singers.

ctx.x: Or was he, did he have a, was he in town at all or was it just the fact that these recordings were made and you heard him?

Yes, I used to hear him on the old 78s and I also heard King Oliver and, and on a lot of music because my father used to play the old 78 records. He had a lot of 78 records with blues by Betsy Smith, Mamie Smith, Ida Cox and all these singers.
